name: Ebola & haemorrhagic fevers
summary: DR Congo Ebola at 10,741 cases on 5 Nov per ECDC; ministry reported 11,042 cases and 5,387 deaths on 11 Nov
state: ECDC reported on 6 Nov that DR Congo had 10,741 confirmed cases and 5,230 deaths, with community transmission in eight provinces, Ituri the worst affected (ECDC). DR Congo's health ministry announced 11,042 cases and 5,387 deaths on 11 Nov (AP). Kenya has nine cases and two deaths, none new since 20 Oct, and Nigeria's single case of 20 Oct was evacuated to Switzerland. Cases far exceed the 1,000 Alert line.
for_you: Risk to people in the UK and Europe is very low, per ECDC. Anyone travelling to DR Congo or neighbouring countries should follow FCDO travel advice, and anyone unwell within 21 days of return should follow NHS and UKHSA guidance on calling ahead before seeking care.
rubric_hit: More than 1,000 cases: 10,741 confirmed in DR Congo on 5 Nov (ECDC) > 1,000 Alert line
basis_detail: WHO, Africa CDC and ECDC case counts
basis_by: WHO, Africa CDC and ECDC case counts

sources.title: AP via NPR/WEAA — Ebola tops 11,000 cases in Congo's deadliest outbreak

why: Ebola, Marburg and similar viruses kill a large share of those infected; outbreaks that reach cities or cross borders can overwhelm health systems.
drivers: Surveillance and contact tracing, vaccine availability (none licensed for some strains), conflict, cross-border travel, health-worker infections.

rubric.alert: More than 1,000 cases, or spread to a new country in the past 30 days.
rubric.watch: An active outbreak contained within one country, or fewer than 1,000 cases.
rubric.normal: No active Ebola/Marburg outbreak, or outbreaks declining with no new countries affected in 60 days.
